entry_semantics.statement: rev: a 40-hex lane commit (green entries may say REV, the checker's --rev, for a corrected statement whose commit does not exist yet); path: canonical lane-relative; line_regex: exactly one line of `git show rev:path` (split on \n, numbered like grep -n) matches. Its required (?P<stated>...) group quotes the claimed number (digits or an English number word) as a standalone token. A fraction claim (N/D, N of D) also captures (?P<den>...) with only '/' or 'of' between the two; any other claim has no den group and its stated number must not sit in a fraction
entry_semantics.stated: the integer the statement asserts (a fraction's numerator); must equal the (?P<stated>...) text
entry_semantics.derive: argv: `python3 -I .ufo/waves/round-20/tally-check.py <subcommand>` plus `--flag value` pairs, each flag at most once: receipt-files --rev --path; pointer-token --counter --counter-rev --rev --token; selftest-labels --path --old --new --label-id. Revisions are 40-hex (REV only in green entries). --path/--counter is never the statement file; a --token or --label-id value occurs as a word in the statement line. Runs with cwd = lane over committed bytes only. extract_regex: begins (?m)^<key>= with a headline key (receipt-files files|distinct_paths|jsonl_paths; pointer-token current|first_line|any_line, printed and claimed as N/D; selftest-labels removed_occurrences|removed_distinct|added_occurrences|added_distinct). It matches stdout exactly once, and its group 1 (or (?P<derived>...)) must equal the N of the one `<key>=` line.
entry_semantics.note: what is counted, how, and the measured value

set_semantics.red: stale round-19 statements, every revision pinned 40-hex: each must print MISMATCH (`--set red` exits 1; `--set red --expect` exits 0 only when every red mismatches)
set_semantics.green: corrected statements (L1 adds them, usually at REV): each must print MATCH (`--set green --rev <commit>` exits 0); an empty set exits 2, never a vacuous pass
